_meta.note: A recognized SES eventType whose event block is missing must map to [] rather than throwing, and the poller must DELETE the message and count sqs_parse_errors_total{reason="malformed_payload"}. This is deliberately distinct from the skip path: Send and DeliveryDelay are EXPECTED to produce no events and increment events_skipped_total, so the two must never share a denominator.
_meta.currentBehavior: lib/event-mapper.js:18-26 dereferences sesEvent.delivery.recipients / .bounce.bouncedRecipients / .complaint.complainedRecipients unguarded, while mapSesEvent:79 already guards `sesEvent.bounce &&` for bounceType. A missing block therefore throws a TypeError that rejects the chain in lib/sqs-poller.js:120-124 and escapes pollOnce WITHOUT ever calling deleteMessage. The message returns on visibility timeout, throws again, and repeats forever — events stop flowing and Ghost's analytics silently freeze.
_meta.acceptedTradeOff: A message that would previously have been retried is now discarded. The failure is deterministic — the same payload throws identically on every redelivery — so retrying could only ever re-throw. Discarding converts an unbounded stall into a single counted event.

mapSesEventReturnsEmpty.name: bounce-missing-bounce-block
mapSesEventReturnsEmpty.note: mapSesEvent already guards `sesEvent.bounce &&` when choosing severity, so this payload reaches getRecipients with a Transient mapping and then throws there. The guard must cover getRecipients too.

pollerBehavior.note: Drive pollOnce with an SQS message whose Body is one of the payloads above (raw or SNS-enveloped — both must behave identically).

metrics.ghost_ses_proxy_events_skipped_total: must NOT be incremented — a malformed payload is a parse error, not a skip

contrastWithTheSkipPath.note: These are the payloads that legitimately produce no events. They must keep incrementing events_skipped_total and must NOT increment sqs_parse_errors_total.

cases.note: Unrecognized types collapse to `other` — plan Design Decision P10. This label is fed by untrusted third-party JSON and must stay bounded.
